'''Targis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> he was stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he captured a squad of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] Republic soldiers. He executed one every day in an attempt to bait the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] into an attack. He was eventually killed by a group of Republic-affiliated individuals in their attempt to free the prisoners.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Targis appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Hoth. He is featured in the description of the Prisoner Extraction heroic mission and can be found in the mission's instanced area. While his death is not required by any of the mission's objectives, this article assumes 100% game completion, which means he is killed.
